title: Count both routes to harm
hook: Two stated cases: explore a common denominator for acting and not acting.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How a common denominator for acting and not acting affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Difference, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare a common denominator for acting and not acting in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
